task.title: Change Map Product Docs and Map Engineering Docs icons to green play button
task.description: Update the icons for "Map Product Docs" and "Map Engineering Docs" TreeView items in the VSCode extension sidebar to use green play button icons instead of their current icons.
task.problem: Users should mentally associate play button icons with commands/actions. The current icons on "Map Product Docs" and "Map Engineering Docs" don't communicate that these are runnable commands. The visual language should be: play button = this is a command you can execute.
task.value: Visual consistency that helps users understand that these items are executable commands. Users will immediately recognize green play buttons as "run this" actions, improving discoverability and reducing cognitive load.
task.acceptance-criteria: Given the VSCode extension is loaded And the Kanban View sidebar is visible When the user views the documentation browser sections Then the "Map Product Docs" item displays a green play button icon And the "Map Engineering Docs" item displays a green play button icon
